data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'eorl' meaning noble and 'leon' meaning light. The name Erlene evokes images of purity, radiance, and nobility. The name Erlene carries the meaning “Pure light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erlene usually hope their child will grow to embody pure light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erlene total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
